mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a supply-side shock where manufacturing contraction is offset by housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines and HOUST increases, or interaction effect coefficient is negative in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized), a monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 0.2% signals inflationary pressures prompting Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong housing market demand that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS increases, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth falls below 50,000, it signals weak labor market growth that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where PAYEMS change is below 50,000, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with stable FEDFUNDS signals persistent inflation and tightening monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting trigger condition, or interaction term coefficient in regression is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
